newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain considers to lower VAT on motorway rates.
newsitem.headline: Spain considers to lower VAT on motorway rates.

text.p: Spanish government is considering a cut in VAT taxes to nine percent during the coming year in order to reduce motorways tariffs, Spain's secretary of Exchequer, Juan Costa said on Thursday.

"The government is studying ways to compensate the fiscal burden, in order to reduce it during 1997 to nine percent, which is the difference between the general VAT level and the reduced level," Costa told reporters.
Spain's three VAT rates are 16 percent, seven and the super reduced four percent and are applied to different goods and services.
